record.question: Players A and B play a game in which each player has three coins (20p, 25p and 50p). Each of them selects a coin without the knowledge of the other person. If the sum of the values of the coins is an even number, A wins B's coin. If that sum is an odd number, B wins A's coin. (a) Develop a payoff matrix with respect to Player A (b) Find the optimal strategies for the players.
